scope_name: topic-guided high-recall corpus of Swedish-affiliated quantum research

primary.definition: At least one authorship claims a Nordic or Baltic country (SE, NO, DK, IS, FI, EE, LV, LT) as a publication-time affiliation country.

audit.definition: At least one matched authorship institution has a Nordic or Baltic country code (SE, NO, DK, IS, FI, EE, LV, LT).

pilot.purpose: Archived query-count and sampling probe; do not rerun for the production range.

production.purpose: Topic- and derived-keyword-guided Swedish quantum-paper corpus window.

headline.note: OpenAlex records both journal and conference-proceedings papers as article; distinguish them with primary_location.source.type when reporting.

inclusion_policy.definition: Quantum physics, a quantum phenomenon, a quantum system, or a quantum technology is central to the paper rather than merely mentioned.

ambiguous_when: candidate matched only through a topic taxonomy keyword
candidate belongs to a conditional taxonomy domain
